load_checkpoint: load a PyTorch model checkpoint from a file path or DeepSpeed checkpoint directory to a specified device
interpolate_pos_embedding: interpolate a positional embedding tensor in a state dict to a new sequence length with optional interleave resizing
blockdiag_to_dense_mlp_bert: convert block-diagonal BERT MLP weight tensors in a state dict to dense weight tensors
remove_model_prefix: strip the 'model.' prefix from all keys in a nested state dict and return the flattened state dict
load_checkpoint_deepspeed: load a DeepSpeed distributed model checkpoint by reading the latest tag and extracting the module state dict
